♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon spends most of the day in Libra in Swati in your 7th house, opposite Jupiter with Ketu at the very start of Leo in your 5th. With the Sun and retrograde Mercury also in Libra, this is a strongly relational day: other people act as a mirror for your creativity, pride and vulnerabilities. Mars, your ruler, still in late Cancer in Ashlesha at the base of your chart, keeps emotions close to the surface around home and family. Notice where your instinct is to react fast, and where it’s wiser to breathe and listen.

💼 Career: Agreements, client interactions and negotiations are highlighted. The Libra cluster in your 7th suggests discussions about responsibilities, timelines or terms can move forward if you’re willing to genuinely hear the other side. Jupiter–Ketu in your 5th can bring a subtle shift in creative direction—something you used to be attached to may no longer feel essential, making room for a more authentic style. Mars in the 4th warns against letting domestic tensions spill into professional behavior; keep boundaries between private irritation and public conduct.

❤️ Love: The Moon in Swati can make you crave both connection and independence. In relationships, this may show up as wanting closeness but resisting any hint of control. If partnered, it’s a good day to renegotiate unspoken “rules” in a fair, calm way—especially around how decisions are made. If single, you may feel drawn to someone who moves easily through social spaces yet guards their deeper layers; take time to learn what’s real beneath the charm.

💰 Money: Jupiter with Ketu in the 5th asks for discernment around speculative ventures, entertainment spending or risks taken for fun. You might feel simultaneously optimistic and oddly detached—use that to review whether certain financial risks actually fit your long-term aims. Contracts or financial commitments involving others (7th house) benefit from balanced terms; check that you’re not over-shouldering responsibility out of impatience to “just get it done.”

🧘 Advice: Let today’s interactions refine your leadership; you don’t lose power by sharing the steering wheel on the route, only by ignoring the map others can see.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The ally who slows you down a little today may be the reason you avoid a larger detour later.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Libra Moon moves through Swati in your 6th house of work, health and daily structure, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury there. Your ruler Venus continues retrograde at the very end of Virgo in Chitra, straddling the edge of your 5th–6th houses, while Jupiter with Ketu in early Leo activate your 4th house of home and emotional roots. This creates a practical but sensitive atmosphere: small choices about how you spend your time touch deeper questions of security and pride.

💼 Career: This is a hands-on day. Tasks that involve coordinating teams, scheduling, organizing information or balancing competing priorities are front and center. With Mercury retrograde, a past project or obligation might resurface, asking for edits or completion. Venus at 29° Virgo encourages you to refine your craft—tighten up a presentation, polish design details, or clean up systems. You may also notice where perfectionism is eating time that could be used more strategically.

❤️ Love: Your mind is on whether your relationships fit into your real life, not just your ideal life. If partnered, conversations may orient around chores, health, or how you share everyday responsibilities. Quiet gestures of support—help with an errand, a meal prepared, a genuine check-in about stress—speak louder than romantic speeches. If single, you may feel a quiet pull toward someone you interact with regularly in practical contexts, where you already see how they behave under routine pressure.

💰 Money: The 6th-house focus nudges you to think about income as a result of consistent effort and clean habits. It’s a reasonable day to adjust your budget or your pricing based on the actual time tasks take. Jupiter in the 4th can point to domestic or property-related expenses or plans; you could be contemplating an upgrade in living conditions or investing in family comfort. Let Venus in Virgo help you distinguish between meaningful improvements and purchases that simply soothe anxiety.

🧘 Advice: Treat your schedule as sacred real estate; every small boundary you place around your time today is a quiet declaration of what your life is really for.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you handle one humble task now teaches the universe how much you can be trusted with the bigger ones.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati lights up your 5th house of intelligence, creativity, children and romance, joining the Sun and your ruler, retrograde Mercury. Venus retrograde at the tail of Virgo in Chitra sharpens your awareness of home and inner foundations in your 4th house, while Jupiter conjunct Ketu at the start of Leo energizes your 3rd house of learning and communication. Your mind is bright, but there’s a subtle clearing of old ideas to make room for something more aligned.

💼 Career: This is a productive day for conceptual or expressive work—writing, design, marketing, teaching, problem-solving. You may revisit an earlier pitch, course, or piece of content and see a new angle that’s more playful and persuasive. Mercury retrograde can bring feedback from the past; instead of defending old versions of yourself, consider what they can teach you about your true strengths. Jupiter–Ketu in the 3rd favors distilling your message: less noise, more impact.

❤️ Love: The 5th house emphasis brings a lighter, more romantic flavor, but Swati’s independent breeze means you also value personal space. If partnered, doing something that feels like shared play—games, a creative project, or a spontaneous outing—can refresh connection. Don’t be surprised if an old inside joke or memory resurfaces. If single, you may be magnetized to someone whose words or humor feel unusually liberating; look for curiosity and integrity beneath the charm.

💰 Money: Creative projects, speculative ideas, or side hustles may feel tempting, but Jupiter with Ketu in the 3rd reminds you not to scatter your focus. Choose one or two initiatives to back with consistent communication rather than chasing every possibility. Venus in late Virgo can help you make practical upgrades to your workspace or tools that improve your output without going overboard on cost.

🧘 Advice: Follow the ideas that make you feel more like yourself, not the ones that only impress other people on paper.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The joke you almost don’t say, the idea you nearly dismiss—one of those may be the doorway your future is waiting at.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, moves through Libra in Swati in your 4th house of home, roots and emotional grounding, joined by the Sun and retrograde Mercury. Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha in your 1st keeps your own desires and irritations vivid, while Jupiter with Ketu at the start of Leo in your 2nd highlights values and resources. Today’s mood is introspective but not passive: you’re invited to rearrange your inner and literal space so it reflects who you’re becoming.

💼 Career: You may be less drawn to public spotlight and more focused on stabilizing your base—organizing files, clarifying priorities, or renegotiating work-from-home arrangements. Emotional responses to colleagues or managers could be stronger than usual; before reacting, ask whether a current situation is echoing an older story of not being heard. Jupiter in the 2nd supports long-term growth in income, but Ketu suggests trimming roles or tasks that no longer feel aligned with your sense of worth.

❤️ Love: With your 4th house lit, your need for emotional safety becomes non-negotiable. If partnered, conversations may revolve around living arrangements, family, or what “home” feels like to each of you. Swati’s airy nature encourages honest but flexible dialogue—aim for adjustments that give both of you more breathing space. If single, you might feel more protective of your privacy and drawn to people who respect your rhythms rather than pushing for quick access.

💰 Money: Jupiter with Ketu in your 2nd can feel like a spiritual audit of your material life. You might feel compelled to simplify—selling or donating items, canceling services you don’t use, or rethinking what “security” actually means for you. The Libra emphasis suggests shared financial decisions with family members or housemates may need rebalancing; kindness plus clear numbers will go further than emotional pressure.

🧘 Advice: Let your body be the judge; if a plan or environment tightens your chest, that’s a valid data point, not something to override.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The corner you make more comfortable today could become the launchpad for your next brave move.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati travels through your 3rd house of communication, siblings and short journeys, alongside the Sun—your ruler—and retrograde Mercury. Meanwhile, Jupiter closely conjoined with Ketu at the very start of your own sign, Leo, in Magha, stirs deeper shifts in identity and purpose. Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha activates your 12th house, bringing old frustrations or hidden desires to the surface. Your mind is buzzing, and your words carry more karmic weight than usual.

💼 Career: Emails, proposals, meetings, interviews—anything that involves your voice or writing—is emphasized. You may need to revisit a previous conversation or contract, this time with clearer awareness of your own non-negotiables. Jupiter–Ketu in your 1st suggests you’re quietly releasing an outdated image or role; you may feel less interested in proving yourself and more focused on working where your presence truly matters. Mars in the 12th is best used for behind-the-scenes effort—research, strategy, or clearing logistical clutter that has been draining you.

❤️ Love: Today favors open but not heavy dialogue. Casual chats can turn revealing, especially with siblings or someone in your neighborhood. If partnered, a drive, a walk, or running errands together can lead to sincere exchanges about how each of you is changing. If single, you may feel drawn to someone whose ideas or curiosity feel refreshing rather than overwhelming. Be honest about your current capacity; it’s okay to move slower than your charisma invites.

💰 Money: The 3rd-house Moon supports sorting out small but meaningful financial tasks—clarifying subscriptions, checking statements, following up on a delayed payment. Jupiter in your sign can bring opportunities and confidence, but Ketu tempers impulsive spending driven by image. Consider whether each purchase actually supports the person you’re becoming, not the persona you’ve outgrown.

🧘 Advice: Speak as if your words are planting seeds in your own path—because in a subtle way, they are.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The story you stop repeating about yourself today frees up energy to live a truer one tomorrow.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati lights your 2nd house of income, speech and self-worth, where it joins the Sun and your ruler, retrograde Mercury. Venus retrograde at 29° Virgo in Chitra intensifies self-awareness in your 1st house, while Jupiter with Ketu in early Leo activates your 12th house of retreat and the unconscious. You’re in a reflective but practical mood, weighing what you share with the world against what you quietly keep for yourself.

💼 Career: This is an excellent day for assessing how well your outer work reflects your inner competence. You may be prompted to renegotiate pay, update a job description, or rethink how you present your skills. Mercury retrograde suggests that an old employer, client or project could re-enter the picture with new terms on the table. Venus in your sign asks you to honor your own style instead of forcing yourself into a mold that wins quick approval but drains you over time.

❤️ Love: Your sensitivity to tone and respect is heightened. If partnered, money or practical responsibilities may come up, but the real question underneath is: “Do we value each other fairly?” Approach this gently, focusing on shared solutions rather than scorekeeping. If single, you may feel less willing to accept half-hearted attention. Subtle actions—who shows up when it’s inconvenient—will speak louder than romantic words.

💰 Money: With so much 2nd-house activation, finances are under a clear but calm microscope. It’s a good time to update budgets, review ongoing expenses, or refine your pricing if you’re self-employed. Jupiter–Ketu in the 12th warns against unconscious drains: small leaks, generous lending that never returns, or purchases aimed at numbing rather than nourishing. Redirecting even one of these patterns frees up more stability than you might expect.

🧘 Advice: Treat your standards not as a burden but as a compass; they’re not here to make you rigid, they’re here to keep you from disappearing into what doesn’t fit.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every time you ask to be valued accurately, you teach your future what to send more of.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Swati passes through your own sign, Libra, in your 1st house, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury. Venus, your ruler, is retrograde at the very end of Virgo in Chitra in your 12th house, while Jupiter with Ketu at the start of Leo energizes your 11th house of community and long-term aims. You stand at an in-between point: visible enough to be noticed, yet inwardly in the midst of a subtle reset about who you are and which groups you truly belong to.

💼 Career: You’re more easily seen today—through meetings, public interactions, or simply the way your presence shifts a room. With Mercury retrograde in your 1st, words you’ve already said may be revisited, perhaps as a chance to clarify your position or correct a misunderstanding. Venus in the 12th invites you to step back briefly from constant feedback; your best career decisions now come from quiet inner alignment, not from crowd approval. Jupiter–Ketu in the 11th favors trimming social or professional networks to the relationships that are genuinely reciprocal.

❤️ Love: The spotlight is on your needs and boundaries. If partnered, conversations may center on your personal changes and what support looks like as you evolve. Be honest about where you’re tired of pretending everything is “fine” when it isn’t. If single, your magnetism is high, but you may feel strangely selective—less willing to play the charming host and more interested in people who can meet you in emotional honesty and mutual respect.

💰 Money: Community commitments can have financial implications today—membership fees, group projects, shared expenses among friends. Jupiter in the 11th offers opportunities through allies and networks, but Ketu suggests you say no to obligations that cost more than they nourish. Reflect on where you might be spending to maintain an image in certain circles rather than to support your actual goals.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to be balanced, not endlessly accommodating; harmony built on self-erasure won’t hold.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you stop apologizing for your real limits is the moment your real people can finally find you.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati moves through your 12th house of rest, endings and the subconscious, together with the Sun and retrograde Mercury. Mars, your traditional ruler, remains in late Cancer in Ashlesha in your 9th house of beliefs and higher learning, and Jupiter with Ketu sits at the start of Leo in your 10th house of career and visibility. Your inner world is active; ideas about your path, faith and public role are shifting quietly behind the scenes.

💼 Career: Outwardly, this may look like a low-key day, but important realizations are forming. Jupiter–Ketu in your 10th suggests a refinement of ambition: you might feel less drawn to titles for their own sake, more to work that feels meaningful. The 12th-house emphasis favors strategy over show—planning next steps, cleaning up old files, or considering which roles you may eventually phase out. Mars in the 9th supports study, mentoring or travel-related projects; just watch for rigidity around your own opinions.

❤️ Love: Old emotional stories can float up from the depths—memories, dreams, or unspoken feelings about past connections. Rather than taking this as a sign to revive what’s over, consider it an invitation to finally integrate the lesson and release lingering resentment. If partnered, soft, late-night style conversations or sharing a spiritual or reflective practice can deepen intimacy. If single, you may sense more clearly what kind of bond would feel restful to your nervous system, even if you’re not ready to act on it yet.

💰 Money: Today is better for reviewing financial background than for bold new moves. Check on subscriptions, automatic payments, or forgotten accounts; small corrections here can ease pressure. Jupiter in the 10th may be expanding your professional earning potential, but Ketu asks you to be selective about which opportunities you chase. Don’t underprice yourself out of old fear of being seen.

🧘 Advice: Treat quiet time as part of your work, not a break from it; your next decisive move will come from this deeper clarity.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The fear you sit still with today loses much of the power it had when you kept running from it.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati activates your 11th house of friends, communities and long-term visions, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury there. Your ruler Jupiter sits with Ketu at the very start of Leo in your 9th house of purpose, wisdom and horizons, while Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha energizes your 8th house of shared resources and psychological depth. Big-picture aspirations and deeper emotional truths intersect today.

💼 Career: Teamwork, networking and strategic planning are favored. You may reconnect with a group or collaborator from the past, or revisit a collective project with fresh eyes. Mercury retrograde suggests it’s a good time to adjust expectations and roles so they match reality. Jupiter–Ketu in the 9th can dissolve outdated beliefs about what’s possible for you, opening space for more authentic directions—perhaps involving teaching, publishing or cross-cultural work. Mars in the 8th supports courageous conversations about funding, shared responsibilities or underlying tensions.

❤️ Love: Friendship and romance can blur, especially in group settings or online spaces. If partnered, dreaming together about the future—trips, learning, or shared causes—can bring you closer, provided you also acknowledge practical limits. If single, you might feel drawn to someone who shares your ideals or passion for a cause. Let your intuition notice how they handle power dynamics in groups; it will tell you a lot more than their slogans.

💰 Money: Joint finances, investments or long-term plans may be up for discussion. Mars in the 8th can stir urgency or sensitivity around who contributes what; aim for transparency rather than blame. The 11th-house Moon is favorable for thinking about long-range goals like retirement, education funds, or collaborative ventures. Just avoid agreeing to complex arrangements while key details are still vague—Mercury retrograde rewards careful review.

🧘 Advice: Let your dreams expand, but allow reality to help shape them; the goal is a horizon you can actually walk toward, not just admire.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The people you dare to be honest with about your real hopes become the ones who can truly help you reach them.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati climbs through your 10th house of career and public standing, joined by the Sun and retrograde Mercury. Saturn, your ruler, continues retrograde in Pisces in Uttara Bhadrapada in your 3rd house, emphasizing measured communication. Jupiter tightly conjoined with Ketu at the start of Leo moves through your 8th house of shared resources and inner transformation, while Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha lights up your 7th house of partnerships. Responsibility, visibility and cooperation are strongly linked today.

💼 Career: You’re more on display than usual—through evaluations, leadership moments or high-visibility tasks. The Libra focus suggests your diplomatic skills matter as much as your work ethic. Mercury retrograde may reopen a previous discussion about your role, title or responsibilities; this is a chance to bring your current reality to the table. Jupiter–Ketu in the 8th signals an opportunity to simplify complex entanglements—old contracts, profit-sharing, or unspoken obligations—though it may require some courage to name what’s not working.

❤️ Love: Mars moving through your 7th keeps partnerships active. This can bring passion, but also occasional friction if one of you feels overburdened. If partnered, it’s a useful day to clarify where each of you stands on major commitments—financial, family or professional—and to update agreements accordingly. If single, you may attract strong-willed people who challenge your usual control; choose those who can argue respectfully, not just loudly.

💰 Money: Work-related income and shared finances both come into focus. You may revisit terms of a contract, commission structure or loan. Jupiter in the 8th can bring growth in joint resources, but Ketu presses you to cut away arrangements based on guilt or fear. Read documents carefully and ask questions instead of assuming everyone’s understanding matches yours.

🧘 Advice: Lead with both spine and flexibility; being fair does not require you to be endlessly self-sacrificing.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you draw clearly around your efforts today becomes the frame that protects your future success.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati travels through your 9th house of wisdom, travel and worldview, together with the Sun and retrograde Mercury. Saturn, your ruler, is retrograde in Pisces in Uttara Bhadrapada in your 2nd house of values and resources. Jupiter conjoined with Ketu at the start of Leo activates your 7th house of partnerships, while Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha energizes your 6th house of work and health routines. Big philosophical questions touch very practical concerns today.

💼 Career: You may be drawn to learning, training or revisiting long-term plans related to your vocation. The Libra focus in your 9th supports conversations with mentors, exploring courses, or rethinking projects that connect you to a wider audience. Saturn in the 2nd keeps you grounded: whatever you envision should eventually translate into sustainable income and self-respect. Jupiter–Ketu in the 7th can bring subtle turning points in key work relationships—certain collaborations may deepen, others may quietly fade if they no longer align with your evolving ethics.

❤️ Love: Partnerships are a major theme. If partnered, discussions about belief systems, future directions, or cultural backgrounds can arise. Approach these with curiosity rather than a need to persuade. Travel or shared study (even a documentary or book) can open new understanding between you. If single, you might feel drawn to people from different places or with unusual perspectives; notice whether their actions match their ideals over time.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd encourages disciplined handling of resources. Today is good for reviewing long-term financial education—learning about investments, savings plans or fair compensation in your field. Mars in the 6th fuels effort but can trigger impatience with financial delays; channel that energy into improving skills that can raise your earning power rather than venting at circumstances.

🧘 Advice: Let your principles shape your habits one small choice at a time; a belief that never reaches your calendar stays an idea, not a path.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The standard you quietly refuse to lower today becomes the invisible line that guides your future alliances.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati moves through your 8th house of shared resources, depth and transformation, alongside the Sun and retrograde Mercury. Your traditional ruler Jupiter sits with Ketu at the very start of Leo in your 6th house of work, health and service, while Saturn continues retrograde in your sign, Pisces, in Uttara Bhadrapada. Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha energizes your 5th house of creativity and romance. This is a clarifying day around what you give, what you receive, and how you handle intensity.

💼 Career: Complex projects and behind-the-scenes problem-solving may take center stage. The 8th-house Moon suggests you’ll be attuned to undercurrents—unspoken concerns, unequal efforts or hidden inefficiencies. Mercury retrograde favors revisiting agreements around workload or support; you can propose more balanced structures now. Jupiter–Ketu in the 6th invites you to release habits of over-service that dilute your effectiveness; doing fewer things with full integrity may serve you better than saying yes to everything.

❤️ Love: Emotional honesty is highlighted. If partnered, topics like trust, long-term commitments, or shared responsibilities may surface. Approach these as maintenance rather than crisis—an opportunity to update old assumptions. If single, you may feel magnetized to emotionally intense or mysterious people; let Saturn in your sign remind you to honor your boundaries and pacing. Not every strong feeling needs immediate action.

💰 Money: Shared finances, debts, loans or inheritances come into focus. It’s a good time to list all obligations and resources clearly and see where renegotiation is possible. Jupiter in the 6th can support gradual improvement through steady effort—setting up realistic repayment plans or streamlining expenses tied to work. Avoid money decisions made primarily to avoid discomfort or confrontation; Libra’s influence rewards fairness and transparency.

🧘 Advice: Let depth be grounding, not drowning; you’re allowed to take breaks from heavy conversations to remember what’s still simple and good.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The truth you face calmly today can turn a long-standing worry into the doorway of your next growth.
